Rae (marketing): Team — shipping release next Thursday. Need: pinned changelog URL, docs examples, 3 short bench bullets, and webinar demo owner by EOD Tue. Who can own demo? @Tess?
Tess (eng): Happy to. Plan to demo live canary toggle + latency dashboard. Need changelog URL and sample curl with new cache header.
Mika (eng): Changelog final is at https://redwood.internal/changelogs/release-1719 (wip). Added note about default_batch_size and cache TTL.
Lina (docs): I'll update quickstart with curl + python snippets including X-Cache-Prefetch. ETA Wed 10:00 PT.
Ishaan (marketing): For marketing copy: three bullets — p50 delta, p95 delta, token cost %. Omar pls confirm safe numbers.
Omar (product): Use conservative: p50 ~50% lower, p95 ~25% lower on 2k seq baseline; token cost ~20% lower with prefix cache + quant. I'll DM the exact cells.
Rae (marketing): Webinar time 9:30am PT release morning. Tess demo, Omar product narrative, Rae moderates. Slides + bench CSV needed.
Mika (eng): Bench CSVs at s3://bench/1719/summary.csv. ops-bot: preflight queued (docs_publish, changelog_pin, cdn_purge, webhook_test, slides).
Lina (docs): Legal blurb approved: "Private deployments keep data in customer VPCs." Adding to post and docs.
Ishaan (marketing): Inbound CTA should post utm_campaign=rls-1719 and model_hint params to https://hooks.redwood.com/leads. Who smoke-tests?
Tess (eng): I'll run a smoke test from staging and paste the curl here.
ops-bot: Preflight update: docs_publish=queued, changelog_pin=queued, webhook_test=pending.
Rae (marketing): Final owners: slides (Ishaan), demo script (Tess), docs publish (Lina), changelog pin (Mika), webhook test (Tess), bench confirm (Mika). Dry run Sat 09:00 PT. If blocked, reply here and tag me.
